description.zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为**zh**。取值：
- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

description.zh:
解析线路，默认为**default**。
参见：
<props="china">[解析线路枚举](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29807.html)。</props>
<props="intl">[解析线路枚举](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/doc-detail/29807.htm)。</props>
description.en:
The resolution line. Default value: **default**.

For more information, see

[DNS resolution lines](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/doc-detail/29807.htm).

description.zh:
MX记录的优先级，取值范围：`[1,50]`。

记录类型为MX记录时，此参数必填。
description.en:
The priority of the mail exchanger (MX) record. Valid values: `1 to 50`.

This parameter is required if the type of the DNS record is MX.

description.zh:
主机记录。
当设置主域名解析（如example.com）时，主机记录应填写"@"符号。
description.en:
The hostname.

For example, if you want to resolve @.example.com, you must set RR to an at sign (@) instead of leaving it empty.

description.zh: 解析记录的ID。可通过调取[DescribeDomainRecords](~~2357159~~)接口获取。
description.en:
The ID of the Domain Name System (DNS) record.

You can call the [DescribeDomainRecords](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomainrecords?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d\_0) operation to obtain the ID.

description.zh:
解析生效时间，默认为600秒（10分钟）。
参见：
<props="china">[TTL定义说明](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29806.html)。</props>
<props="intl">[TTL定义说明](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/doc-detail/29806.htm)。</props>
description.en:
The time to live (TTL) period of the Alibaba Cloud DNS (DNS) record. Default value: 600. Unit: seconds.

For more information, see

[TTL definition](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/doc-detail/29806.htm).

description.zh:
解析记录类型，参见：
<props="china">[解析记录类型格式](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29805.html)。</props>
<props="intl">[解析记录类型格式](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/doc-detail/29805.htm)。</props>
description.en:
The type of the DNS record. For more information, see

[DNS record types](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/doc-detail/29805.htm).
The IP address of the client.
The value of the DNS record.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns update-domain-record --lang en --user-client-ip 192.0.2.1 --record-id 990000000 --rr @ --type A --value 192.0.2.1 --ttl 600 --priority 1 --line default --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns UpdateDomainRecord --region cn-hangzhou --RR '@' --Line default --Type A --Priority 1 --UserClientIp '192.0.2.1' --Value '192.0.2.1' --Lang en --RecordId 990000000 --TTL 600
